areas.name: Nymindegab Plantage
areas.notes: Tier 2 state_forest_like, Jutland. Rescoped as ONE west-coast dune-plantation destination: the Nymindegab Plantage relation is the container; the Blåbjerg Klitplantage routes and the Houstrup Strand Rød route come in through include_trails (whole OSM relations). Sibling blabjerg-klitplantage-dk stays held merge-pending and must never be published. Stale dk-v2 excludes re-curated on dk-v3: the six -vej stitches re-confirmed (tracks/paths with road names, no route relation); Paradis Stien dropped (0.36 mi stitch); Houstrup Strand Rød is now included whole. bbox/center computed by the qualify run. Release note: not checked against a Naturstyrelsen route page, complete as far as OSM shows.
